rows.Bloom: Dark red, darker undertones. Deep red blooms with velvety black tones. Strong, rose, vanilla fragrance. Large, double (17-25 petals), cluster-flowered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.

Glossy, dark green foliage.
